content.title: First Four highlights, scores: Texas edges NC State, Howard beats UMBC
content.text: March 17, 2026Updated March 18, 2026, 1:58 a.m. ETBefore the first round of the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament tips off Thursday, launching a frenzied 36-hour stretch featuring 32 games, the madness of March gets started Tuesday night.The First Four marks the official start of the NCAA tournament, with eight teams descending on UD Arena in Dayton, Ohio, for four play-in games that will determine the 64-team bracket for the Big Dance. The event includes the four lowest-rated No. 16 seeds and the four final at-large selections, all of which are No. 11 seeds this year.This year, the festivities got rolling on March 17 with a pair of matchups: No. 16 Howard vs. No. 16 UMBC and No. 11 Texas vs. No. 11 NC State.With an 86-83 victory, the first NCAA tournament win in program history, Howard advanced to take on No. 1 seed Michigan. In the nightcap, fans were gifted another thriller, with Texas getting a pair of late jumpers from Tramon Mark, including one with 1.1 seconds left, to get a 68-66 win over fellow No. 11 seed NC State and advance to take on No. 6 seed BYU.Both of those first-round games will take place on Thursday, March 19.USA TODAY Sports has a team of journalists covering the Men's NCAA Tournament to keep you up to date with every point scored, rebound grabbed and game won in the 68-team tournament.Follow along below for live updates from the first day of the First Four:Join the USA TODAY Bracket Challenge for your shot at $1 million Texas vs NC State First Four live scoreThis section will be updated throughout the game1H2HFTexas303868NC State293766 First Four live updatesThis section will be updated throughout the gameTexas edges NC State for First Four winTramon Mark's last-second jumper proves to be the difference, with Texas holding on for a 68-66 win against NC State in a matchup of No. 11 seeds in the First Four. The Wolfpack had a chance to tie or win the game, with 1.1 seconds left, but a Darrion Williams attempted 3 from just inside midcourt is blocked by Dailyn Swain.With the victory, Texas moves on to take on No. 6 seed BYU on Thursday. Mark scored all four of the Longhorns' points in the final 40 seconds, with a pair of jumpers.Tramon Mark jumper puts Texas in frontTexas coughed up its lead, but just got it back thanks to one of its best players — and, most likely, picked up an NCAA tournament win.With the score tied at 66, Tramon Mark takes a defender one-on-one and buries a deep, step-back 2-pointer with a second remaining to put the Longhorns on a precipice of victory.Paul McNeil Jr. catching fire for NC StateNC State looked to be about done, trailing Texas by eight with 1:35 remaining. But the Wolfpack have gotten a pair of 3-pointers from Paul McNeil Jr. in a span of just 24 seconds, getting his team within two, 64-62, with 1:06 remaining.We've got a ballgame. God bless you, March.Texas, NC State exchange dunksIt's still a three-point game between Texas and NC State, with the Longhorns holding a 54-51 advantage. For all the offensive struggles tonight, we got a couple of highlight-reel worthy plays, with NC State's Quadir Copeland throwing down a reverse alley-oop and Nic Codie responding on the other end with a put-back jam.Texas hanging on vs NC StateWe've still got a tight one in Dayton, with Texas leading NC State 41-38 with 11:49 remaining and the Wolfpack going to the line for a pair of free throws.Neither team is shooting particularly well, with the Longhorns at 30.2% and the Wolfpack at 34.1%. Texas takes one-point lead into halftime over NC StateAfter a high-scoring, fast-paced Howard vs. UMBC game kicked off the First Four, the back end of Tuesday's double-header hasn't been quite as offensively explosive, with Texas carrying a 30-29 lead over NC State heading into the locker room.The Longhorns led by as many as 10, but finished the half ice cold, missing their final 10 shots. The Wolfpack capitalized a bit, scoring six unanswered in the final 2:19 of the half to get within one. NC State's Darrion Williams leads all scorers with 10 points while Dailyn Swain has a team-high seven for Texas.Texas in control early vs NC StateAt the under-eight media timeout, Texas has a 25-19 lead over NC State with 5:40 remaining in the first half. The Longhorns jumped out to a 9-2 lead and have led by as many as 10.Coach Sean Miller's team has made five of nine shots from 3-point range, but is just three of 11 from inside the arc. Darrion Williams of the Wolfpack leads all scorers with 10 points. UMBC vs Howard First Four live scoreThis section will be updated throughout the game1H2HFHoward493786UMBC414283 Howard vs UMBC live updatesThis section will be updated throughout both gamesFINAL: Howard 86, UMBC 83Howard makes history by earning its first-ever NCAA tournament victory. Before the final buzzer sounded, it had to sweat just a little bit.Leading by 11, 83-72, with 1:55 remaining, the Bison were outscored 11-3 the rest of the way. They had a chance to ice the game with a pair of free throws and a two-point lead with 5.5 seconds remaining, but Isaiah Brown missed the second of two free throws, giving UMBC a chance to tie the game. A deep 3-pointer from DJ Armstrong Jr. at the buzzer sailed to the right, though, allowing Howard to hang on.The Bison will take on No. 1 seed Michigan on Thursday, March 19.UMBC mounting furious comebackThe Retrievers may end up losing this game, but they aren't letting their season end without a fight. UMBC is on a 9-0 run over the past 1:11 to get within two, 83-81, with 41 seconds remaining after a 3-pointer from DJ Armstrong Jr., prompting a Howard timeout. The Retrievers don't need to foul here, though the Bison have missed on the front end of a one-and-one on each of their past two possessions.Howard closing in on First Four winAt the final media timeout, with 3:19 remaining, Howard leads UMBC 81-72. The Bison have been out in front throughout the second half, leading by as many as 14, but never being able to put away the Retrievers, who have gotten as close as five.Three Howard players have at least 16 points: Ose Okojie (with 21), Bryce Harris (17) and Cedric Taylor III (16). Howard leads UMBC at halftimeWe're halfway through the first game of the NCAA tournament and if it's any indication of how the rest of March Madness will go, we're in for a fun three weeks. Howard leads UMBC 49-41, with the teams combining to shoot 50% from the field and 42.9% from 3-point range.Ose Okojie leads all scorers with 16 points for Howard while Jah'Likai King leads UMBC with 11.Howard pulling away from UMBCAn exciting, back-and-forth first half in the first game of the First Four is starting to see one of its teams create some distance.Howard is on a 10-0 run to take a 41-30 lead over UMBC at the final media timeout of the first half, with 3:42 remaining. Ose Okojie has been the catalyst behind the Bison in the first half, with a game-high 16 points on 6-of-9 shooting. Nobody else on either team has more than nine points.What channel is the First Four on?TV channel: truTVStreaming:Sling TVThe two First Four games on Tuesday, March 17 will be airing nationally on truTV.
